levels.representation: engine-native storage object or persistent graph/tree/cache state
levels.semantic_payload: information actually consumed by search control, move ordering, evaluation reuse, pruning or expansion
levels.intervention: remove/suppress the semantic payload at the admitted read boundary while preserving the surrounding search problem
levels.outcome: action/fine exact-world/coarse exact-world changes under fixed resource conditions

alpha_beta_family.stockfish: TT semantic reads already admitted in P13-P19 lineage
alpha_beta_family.berserk: candidate MAIN+QSEARCH TT read topology; requires P20 R1 causal admission
alpha_beta_family.ethereal: candidate MAIN+QSEARCH TT read topology; requires P20 R1 causal admission
alpha_beta_family.inanis: MAIN direct TT read present at source lock; qsearch direct TT-read homology absent at source lock; translation is partial, not missing data to be imputed

lc0_boundary.search_state: neural-guided tree/DAG state is persistent search memory but is not automatically homologous to alpha-beta TT payload
lc0_boundary.neural_eval_cache: memcache returns cached neural evaluation/policy payload and is a distinct candidate persistent-memory channel
future_admission_requires: choose one causal channel before outcome inspection
enumerate every semantic consumer of that channel
separate tree/DAG-state intervention from neural-evaluation-cache intervention unless a mediation theorem justifies aggregation

nonidentity_principle: Two engines may instantiate the same abstract PSM_READ variable without sharing data structures, language, replacement policy, search family or cache topology; equivalence is earned by the intervention contract, not by naming similarity.

language_nonauthority_principle.rule: Implementation language is not an admission variable and cannot by itself support or defeat causal homology.
language_nonauthority_principle.native_first: Instrument each engine in its native implementation and build ecosystem unless a separately validated boundary adapter is required.
forbidden_shortcuts: require Python orchestration as part of the scientific construct
rewrite a native engine into a common language and treat the rewrite as the original causal system
infer mechanism equivalence from shared language, ABI, UCI support or data-structure names
language_nonauthority_principle.comparison_contract: Cross-engine equivalence is earned by complete semantic mediation, NATIVE/SHAM noninterference, semantic-removal equivalence and prospective outcome-blind admission.
